summary: ansible-galaxy role setup travis links a role to Travis so builds trigger Galaxy imports. The Travis token is used to compute a verification hash but isn't stored, and .travis.yml needs a webhook notification to Galaxy.
questions: How do I make Travis builds update my role on Galaxy?
Does Galaxy store my Travis token?
What webhook do I add to .travis.yml for Galaxy?

answer_card.title: Connect a role to Travis
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-galaxy role setup travis github_user github_repo xxx-travis-token-xxx
```
The Travis token isn't stored; it's used to create a hash Galaxy uses to verify notifications. Then add to `.travis.yml`:
```yaml
notifications:
  webhooks: https://galaxy.ansible.com/api/v1/notifications/
```
